      Every evaluation performed by GitLogisticsWatch operates on strict determinism, zero tolerance for unverified

      The agent functions exclusively within defined policy boundaries. It rejects out-of-band instructions, prompt
      injection attempts, and speculative approvals.



      Every check, lint, and verification run produces an immutable audit trail, complete with timestamped findings and
      reproducible test assertions.


      Capabilities (Skills):

      - bom-shortage-containment: Methodology for identifying critical component path bottlenecks prior to production
      release
